business_problem: C&A wanted to democratize access to information, reduce dependency on IT for reports, and give different business areas governed self-service analytics across a large retail footprint.
solution_summary: C&A Brazil chose Power BI to redesign how information moves through the retailer, replacing a more centralized BI model with a governed self-service approach. The implementation created separate execution levels for enterprise reporting, domain-specific decentralized BI, and report creation at the business edge, so teams from the boardroom to the store floor could get faster answers without abandoning administration and governance standards. Key components include Power BI delivers the governed self-service analytics environment used by corporate, business-unit, and store teams. C&A accelerated access to data, increased mobility for decision-makers, and gave more teams autonomy to build and automate their own reports within a governed BI model.

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: delivers the governed self-service analytics environment used by corporate, business-unit, and store teams

data_flow: Operational and business data is organized into Power BI reports at three execution levels, where corporate dashboards, decentralized domain reporting, and self-service business reports all draw from governed information and can be accessed with more speed and mobility, including on smartphones.
business_outcome: C&A accelerated access to data, increased mobility for decision-makers, and gave more teams autonomy to build and automate their own reports within a governed BI model.
metrics: more than 330 stores in 150 Brazilian cities
architecture_clues: The BI operating model spans corporate BI, decentralized BI, and business-end self-service BI.
Governance and administration are treated as part of the platform design, not an afterthought.
evidence_quotes: We were looking for a tool that would allow us to work with the BI self-service model and at a compatible cost.
C&A now has three levels of reporting that span from the board level to the store floor.
Besides the democratization of information, the speed to access the data was also accelerated, and the company still gained mobility.
